content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway is a digital platform that facilitates the processing of cryptocurrencies for online transactions. Unlike traditional payment processors that impose high fees and stringent account requirements, a crypto gateway like NOWPayments offers low transaction fees and no KYC (Know Your Customer) requirements. This is crucial for digital creators in countries facing financial isolation or restrictions imposed by conventional platforms. By leveraging a crypto payment gateway, creators reclaim control over their sales and retain a larger share of their earnings, making it a vital tool for anyone looking to thrive in today’s digital economy.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a sovereign digital commerce stack integrates various components to facilitate seamless transactions. Using platforms like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, these stacks process orders, handle payment verifications, and manage product delivery. For instance, when a customer purchases a digital product, the payment is confirmed on-chain via NOWPayments, triggering automatic file delivery. This architecture not only ensures instant product delivery but also provides creators with complete data ownership. The combination of free hosting, automated payment processing, and file delivery creates a robust framework for digital commerce.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators operating in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Whether you are selling ebooks, online courses, templates, or digital art, this solution empowers you to process payments without depending on platforms that charge hefty fees. By utilizing sovereign commerce stacks, creators can avoid the pitfalls of high transaction costs and retain the majority of their earnings. It levels the playing field, enabling anyone to build a sustainable digital business regardless of their geographic location.
Retain 99.5% of your sales revenue with NOWPayments compared to other platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A complete sovereign stack includes several essential components that work in unison to facilitate digital sales. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free hosting for your online store, while backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage can be handled using Supabase or Google Sheets, both of which are free and user-friendly. For file delivery, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensures that customers receive their purchases instantly upon payment confirmation. Integrating NOWPayments for crypto payment processing adds the final layer of functionality, ensuring a smooth, efficient sales experience without the overhead costs associated with traditional payment platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, start by selecting a free hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order processing. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store your order data securely. For product delivery, choose Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure instant access for your customers. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to facilitate automatic crypto payment processing. By following these steps, you can launch your digital store quickly and efficiently, ensuring you retain complete ownership and control over your sales.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This platform allows for transaction processing in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring low fees and no KYC requirements, which is essential for creators in restricted regions. By implementing a sovereign stack, you can effectively manage sales and retain a larger portion of your earnings.
Instant product delivery enhances customer satisfaction and trust.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those exploring options to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all six blueprints and seven templates you need to establish a sovereign commerce stack. You can find the kit and other resources at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies can I accept using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies from your customers. This flexibility means you can cater to various preferences and maximize the potential customer base for your digital products.
How do I ensure my products are delivered automatically?

By integrating your backend logic with NOWPayments and using automated scripts, you can ensure that digital products are delivered immediately after payment confirmation. This eliminates manual processing and enhances the customer experience.
What are the benefits of using a sovereign stack for my online store?

Using a sovereign stack provides complete ownership of your digital commerce infrastructure. Unlike traditional platforms, you control your data, avoid high fees, and operate without dependency on third-party services, allowing for greater flexibility and profitability.
Can I customize my online store using this system?

Yes, you can customize your online store extensively. The frameworks and templates provided allow for personalization in design and functionality, enabling you to create a unique shopping experience tailored to your brand.
Is technical knowledge required to set this up?

While some basic technical knowledge is helpful, the infrastructure is designed to be user-friendly. With step-by-step guides and templates available in the Complete Builder Kit, you can set up your store without extensive coding experience.
Own your entire sales process with no reliance on third-party platforms.
